arStrings.szText: "I don't have Lilith's blood anymore but even without it, I still may be able to help."
You were meant to be her Chosen. Since the Mother’s fall, I’ve poured over the tomes that once called her back into Sanctuary.

I was close to redesigning Elias’ ritual for our purposes, but during my tests the Faithful were betrayed. A few turned traitor and sabotaged the ritual. They mean to rebirth something else. I didn't find out what.
I had hoped Lilith’s Chosen might help turn them back.
